subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: Which policy should own Feishu delivery recovery after gateway restart: channel-owned reconnect/readiness drain, global startup recovery gating, or retry-count reset across restart boundaries?
rationale: Current source and the merged partial fix show the retry-accounting bug is solved, but choosing how recovery coordinates with channel transport readiness changes core/plugin ownership and retry semantics.

options.title: Use channel-owned readiness drain
options.body: Add a Feishu transport-ready or reconnect-triggered drain that replays eligible pending deliveries once the Feishu WebSocket or webhook listener reports ready, while keeping generic startup recovery best-effort.

options.title: Gate generic startup recovery
options.body: Make outbound startup recovery wait for channel readiness before draining, accepting the added coupling and potential startup stalls across channels.

options.title: Reset retry counts on restart
options.body: Treat a restart as a fresh delivery session for retry accounting, accepting that this could hide real permanent delivery failures unless narrowly constrained.

recommendation.title: Use channel-owned readiness drain
recommendation.body: Add a Feishu transport-ready or reconnect-triggered drain that replays eligible pending deliveries once the Feishu WebSocket or webhook listener reports ready, while keeping generic startup recovery best-effort.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway/release stability work and channel recovery history make this the best available routing owner for the policy choice.
